info.name: Beos Products API
info.description:
REST API for products with multi-currency prices (Laravel 13, Sanctum). 7 endpoints under `/api/v1`.

**Usage**
1. Start the API (`php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` and `php artisan serve`); change `base_url` if it is not `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`.
2. Run the collection with the Collection Runner: Products, then Error cases. Each request stores the variables the next ones need.

**Authentication**: there is no login endpoint. The collection includes two demo tokens created by the seeder (`DEMO_ADMIN_TOKEN` and `DEMO_VIEWER_TOKEN` in `.env.example`) in the `{id}|{secret}` format; `1|` and `2|` are the token ids of a freshly seeded database. `token` (admin, read and write) is sent as Bearer for the whole collection; `viewer_token` (read only) is used by the 403 cases. To issue a new token: `php artisan api:token admin@example.com`.

**Variables**: `base_url`, `token`, `viewer_token`, `usd_id` (1) and `eur_id` (2) are currency ids of a freshly seeded database (there is no currency endpoint); `product_id` and `deleted_product_id` are set by the requests.

Every error response is checked against the unified format `{ message, code, errors?, request_id }`.

item.name: Products
item.description: The 7 endpoints required by the assessment, in execution order. Prices are a sub-resource of a product, so they run before the product is deleted.

request.description: Creates a product (admin role, `products:write` ability). `currency_id` is the base currency of `price`. All fields are required except `description`; amounts accept up to 2 decimals. Returns `201` with a `Location` header. Stores the id in `product_id`.

exec: pm.test('Location points to the product', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql('/api/v1/products/' + data.id));

request.description: Paginated list. Optional parameters: `page`, `per_page` (1-100, default 15), `search` (case-insensitive, on `name`), `currency_id`, `min_price`, `max_price` (inclusive, base price only) and `sort` (`id`, `name`, `price`, `created_at`; `-` prefix for descending, default `-id`).
Returns the product with its base currency embedded.
`PUT` is a full replacement: every required field must be sent (`PATCH` is not supported). Changing `currency_id` does not convert `price`.

item.name: Prices
item.description: Prices of the product in other currencies.

request.description: Registers the product price in another currency (admin role). The currency must exist and differ from the base currency; one price per currency (`409` if it already exists).

exec: pm.test('Location points to the price list', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql('/api/v1/products/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('product_id') + '/prices'));

request.description: Returns only the additional prices (not the base price), ordered by currency code, not paginated.
Soft delete: returns `204` with no body. Its prices are kept but no longer accessible. Stores the id in `deleted_product_id` for the 404 cases.

item.name: Error cases
item.description: Same endpoints with invalid input or insufficient permissions. Starts by creating its own product with an EUR price and deletes it at the end.

request.description: Creates the product used by the error cases.
Registers an EUR price so the duplicate case returns `409`.
Every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
A token that does not exist, is malformed or has expired returns `401`.
The `viewer` role only has `products:read`.
Authorization is checked before validation: `403`, not `422`.
Write denied to `viewer`.
The product is not deleted.
Write denied to `viewer`.
The message does not reveal whether the product never existed or was deleted.
An id that is not a positive integer returns `404`, never `500`.
A soft-deleted product (from Products / Delete product) is no longer accessible.
Also applies to `POST /products/{id}/prices`.
`PUT` is a full replacement; `PATCH` does not exist.
The product already has an EUR price (Setup). The existing price does not change.
`price` must be >= 0.01 and `name` must have 2-255 characters.
There is no partial update.
Only `id`, `name`, `price` and `created_at` are allowed (optional `-` prefix).
The base price lives only in `products.price`; the base currency does not accept an additional price.
A JSON body that cannot be decoded returns `400`.
Deletes the product created for the error cases.
